catalog_description: Glottolog catalogs Norwegian (ISO 639-3: nor) as a language under the Indo-European grouping.

catalog_identity_evidence.evidence_scope: catalog identity and fields only; not an audit of the independent definition or example

definition: A human language with Bokmål and Nynorsk written standards.
entry_text: A human language with Bokmål and Nynorsk written standards.
example: An editor prepares a Norwegian brochure in Nynorsk.
label: Norwegian

sources.note: The Norwegian Language Council explicitly identifies Bokmål and Nynorsk as the two Norwegian written standards.
